1. 定位与边界

1.1 目标

在现有 Python 测试平台 code-case-platform 上新增 Java 项目代码覆盖率采集 能力，支持：

  • 触发 Java 项目测试时自动注入 JaCoCo Agent（-javaagent 或 offline 预插桩）
  • 采集 .exec → 生成报告 → 入库 → 前端展示
  • 与现有 Python coverage.py 覆盖率统一视图（二期）

1.2 不做什么

  • 不自研 Java Agent / 插桩器 / 探针 Runtime —— 全用 JaCoCo 现成 jar
  • 不改业务项目源码 —— Agent 参数在构建/启动时注入，不侵入 pom.xml / build.gradle
  • 不处理线上生产插桩 —— 首版只覆盖"Python 平台触发 Java 构建 + 单元测试"的离线场景
  • 不做分布式多进程合并 —— 首版假设每个 PlanRun 对应单个 .exec 文件

1.3 对接假设

  • Java 项目可被 git clone 拉取
  • 构建工具为 Maven / Gradle / GraalVM Native Image 之一（自动检测）
  • 执行环境为 host 进程（Docker 作为二期），有 JDK 11+

3. 执行流程

3.1 完整时序

3.2 Agent 注入的 4 种策略（自动选择）

class BuildService:
    def _execute(self, build_tool, agent_args, test_command):
        if build_tool == "graalvm_native":
            return self._execute_graalvm_offline(agent_args, test_command)
        elif build_tool in ("maven", "gradle") and self._has_standard_layout():
            return self._execute_standard(build_tool, agent_args, test_command)
        else:
            return self._execute_shell_script(agent_args, test_command)

    def _execute_standard(self, tool, agent_args, test_cmd):
        """标准 Maven/Gradle 项目：系统属性注入 Agent"""
        env = os.environ.copy()
        opts = f"-javaagent:{self.jacoco_agent}={agent_args}"
        if tool == "maven":
            env["MAVEN_OPTS"] = opts
            cmd = test_cmd or "mvn clean test"
        else:
            env["GRADLE_OPTS"] = opts
            cmd = test_cmd or "./gradlew clean test"
        return self._run(cmd, env)

    def _execute_shell_script(self, agent_args, test_cmd):
        """老项目：JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS 兜底"""
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS"] = f"-javaagent:{self.jacoco_agent}={agent_args}"
        return self._run(test_cmd or "java -jar app.jar", env)

    def _execute_graalvm_offline(self, agent_args, test_cmd):
        """GraalVM Native Image：Offline 预插桩"""
        self._run("mvn clean package -DskipTests")
        subprocess.run(["java", "-jar", self.jacoco_cli, "instrument",
            "target/classes", "--dest", "target/instrumented", ...], check=True)
        self._run(["native-image", "-cp",
            f"target/instrumented:{self.jacoco_rt}:.", ...])
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update({"JACOCO_OUTPUT": "file", "JACOCO_DESTFILE": agent_args["destfile"]})
        return self._run("./my-native-app", env)

3.3 统一 Agent 参数生成

class JaCoCoAgentConfig:
    def build_args(self, *, destfile, includes=None, excludes=None, session_id=None) -> str:
        defaults = {
            "destfile": destfile,
            "append": "true",
            "output": "file",
            "includes": ",".join(includes or ["com/yourcompany/**"]),
            "excludes": ",".join(excludes or [
                "**/*Test*.class", "**/*Config*.class",
                "**/*$$Lambda*", "**/*$Proxy*",
            ]),
            "exclclassloaders": ",".join([
                "org.springframework.boot.loader.LaunchedURLClassLoader",
            ]),
            "maxclasses": "100000",
            "classdumpdir": f"dumped-classes/{session_id or 'default'}",
        }
        return ",".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in defaults.items())

package_name / class_name / source_file类标识
lines_total / lines_covered / line_rate类级行覆盖
branches_total / branches_covered / branch_rate类级分支覆盖
complexity (INT)圈复杂度
line_coverage_json (JSON){line_num: 'covered'|'missed'|'partial'}
branch_coverage_json (JSON){line_num: {'missed': N, 'covered': M}}
created_at

4.2 覆盖率任务（新一等实体）

coverage_tasks 是前端 CRUD 的主体——用户通过它来管理"哪一个项目、哪几个服务、哪一个分支、在什么时间、关联什么需求"的覆盖率采集。一个 Project 可以包含多个 Java 服务（monorepo 场景），一个 coverage_task 可以覆盖多个服务，服务是最小采集单位。与 java_coverage_reports 是一对多关系（任务触发一次，每个被选中的服务生成一个 report）。

状态机

字段详情

字段类型说明
idBIGINT PK雪花 ID
project_idBIGINT FK → projects.id关联项目（一个 Project 可以包含多个 Java 服务 / monorepo）
servicesJSON该任务覆盖的服务列表：[{ "name": "order-service", "module": "order", "path": "services/order" }, ...]。服务是最小采集单位，多服务时并行采集
branchVARCHAR(100)目标代码分支，如 main / feature/payment-v2（该分支下所有被选服务统一 checkout 同一个 commit）
target_commit_shaVARCHAR(64) NULL手动指定某个 commit（空则采集 branch HEAD）
build_toolVARCHAR(20)构建工具：maven / gradle / graalvm_native / custom（自动检测）
test_commandVARCHAR(500) NULL可覆盖默认构建命令（mvn clean test），多服务时按 module 分别执行
includes / excludesJSONAgent includes/excludes，覆盖默认值（按服务级可在 services JSON 里各别覆盖）
requirement_refVARCHAR(200) NULL预留字段：关联需求（如 FEATURE-支付通道）。首版支持自由文本输入；二期接入第三方平台（Jira / 飞书项目）后改为下拉联动
owner_idBIGINT FK → users.id负责人
scheduled_atDATETIME NULL一次性定时采集时间（空则表示手动触发）
cron_exprVARCHAR(50) NULL重复定时规则（如 0 2 * * *），空则不重复
threshold_line_rate / threshold_branch_rateDECIMAL(5,2) NULL覆盖率阈值，低于则飞书通知负责人（复用现有 notification 模块）
diff_base_branchVARCHAR(100)增量对比基准分支。默认取 Project 级配置（main / master 等），任务级可覆盖。计算方式 = git merge-base(diff_base_branch, branch)
statusVARCHAR(20)draft / queued / running / completed / failed / cancelled。"主动获取"走异步投递：POST /trigger → 写入 queued → Celery 接单 → 每个服务一个 worker 并行采集
current_run_idBIGINT NULL → java_coverage_runs.id当前正在运行或最后一次采集的 run（一个 run 包含多个服务的 report）
last_completed_at / last_failed_atDATETIME NULL状态时间戳
created_by / updated_by / created_at / updated_at常规审计

4.3 java_coverage_runs（采集批次中间表）

一个 coverage_task 触发一次采集 = 一个 run。run 是 Celery 异步投递的原子单元：记录本次触发了哪些服务、每个服务的采集状态、整体完成情况。

字段类型说明
idBIGINT PK雪花 ID
coverage_task_idBIGINT FK → coverage_tasks.id关联任务
trigger_typeVARCHAR(20)manual / scheduled / api
overall_statusVARCHAR(20)running / partial / completed / failed（多服务下可能部分成功）
services_total / services_completed / services_failedINT本批次覆盖的服务数量统计
started_at / finished_atDATETIME

4.4 java_coverage_reports（单个服务的采集产物）

一个 run 触发 N 个被选服务并行采集 → 生成 N 行 java_coverage_reports。每行代表一个服务在某个 commit 上的完整覆盖率快照。

  • run_id BIGINT FK → java_coverage_runs.id（本次 run）
  • task_id BIGINT FK → coverage_tasks.id（冗余，方便按任务查）
  • service_name VARCHAR(100)（该 report 属于哪个服务）
  • 原有 commit_sha / branch / lines_total / line_rate / branches_... / exec_file_path / xml_report_path / build_tool / status / error_msg 字段不变
  • diff_base_branch VARCHAR(100)（冗余自 task，本 report 用哪个主干算 merge-base）
  • diff_base_commit_sha VARCHAR(64)（缓存本次 diff 实际用的 merge-base commit，避免每次重算）

关系：coverage_task 1 → N runs 1 → N reports（每个 run 的服务数 = reports 数）

4.5 复用 report_files 表

在现有 report_files.report_type 字段新增 3 个枚举值，不新增表：

  • jacoco_html → MinIO 存储整个 HTML 报告目录（压缩上传），前端 iframe 访问
  • jacoco_xml → MinIO 存储 XML 原始报告
  • jacoco_exec → MinIO 存储 .exec 原始文件（备份 + 二次分析）

4.6 Alembic 迁移

基线迁移已入库（commit fb269d3），新增增量迁移：

alembic revision --autogenerate -m "add coverage_tasks and reports"

5. 后端模块设计

5.1 BuildService

async def run_with_coverage(
    self, *, repo_url, commit_sha,
    build_command=None, test_command=None,
    includes=None, excludes=None,
    session_id, workspace=None,
) -> JavaBuildResult:
    workspace = workspace or Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="jacoco-"))
    subprocess.run(["git", "clone", repo_url, str(workspace)], check=True, timeout=300)
    subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", commit_sha], cwd=workspace, check=True)
    build_tool = self._detect_build_tool(workspace)  # pom.xml → maven, build.gradle → gradle, native-image → graalvm
    if build_tool == "graalvm_native":
        return await self.graalvm_service.run(workspace, agent_args, ...)
    agent_args = JaCoCoAgentConfig().build_args(destfile=..., includes=includes, excludes=excludes, session_id=session_id)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["MAVEN_OPTS"] = f"-javaagent:{self.jacoco_agent}={agent_args}"
    env["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS"] = env["MAVEN_OPTS"]  # 兜底
    result = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(*shlex.split(cmd), cwd=workspace, env=env, ...)
    # 校验 coverage.exec 生成 + 大小合理性，否则 raise RuntimeError
    return JavaBuildResult(exec_file, build_log, test_output, exit_code, duration_ms)

5.2 JaCoCoReportService

async def generate_and_store(
    self, *, exec_file, class_dirs, source_dirs,
    commit_sha, session_id, project_id, plan_run_id=None,
) -> int:   # 返回 java_coverage_reports.id
    report = await self.repo.create(project_id, plan_run_id, commit_sha, session_id, status="running")
    subprocess.run(["java", "-jar", self.jacoco_cli, "report", str(exec_file),
        *[a for d in class_dirs for a in ("--classfiles", str(d))],
        *[a for d in source_dirs for a in ("--sourcefiles", str(d))],
        "--xml", str(xml_path), "--html", str(html_dir)], check=True)
    detail_parser = JaCoCoXMLParser()
    overall, details = detail_parser.parse(xml_path)
    await self.repo.update_overall(report.id, overall)
    await self.detail_repo.bulk_insert(report.id, details)
    await self._upload_to_minio(html_dir, xml_path, exec_file, plan_run_id)
    await self.repo.update_status(report.id, "completed")
    return report.id

5.3 XML 解析器（核心）

class JaCoCoXMLParser:
    COUNTER_TYPES = {"INSTRUCTION", "BRANCH", "LINE", "COMPLEXITY", "METHOD", "CLASS"}

    def parse(self, xml_path) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
        root = ET.parse(xml_path).getroot()
        overall = self._extract_counters(root)
        details = []
        for pkg in root.iter("package"):
            pkg_name = pkg.get("name", "")
            for cls in pkg.iter("class"):
                class_id = int(cls.get("id"), 16)   # JaCoCo XML class 元素的 id 就是 CRC64
                counters = self._extract_counters(cls)
                line_map = self._parse_line_hits(cls)
                details.append({"class_id": class_id, "package_name": pkg_name,
                    "class_name": cls.get("name", "").split("/")[-1] + ".class",
                    "source_file": cls.get("sourcefilename"),
                    "line_coverage_json": line_map,
                    **{f"{k}_rate": ... for k in counters}, ...})
        return overall, details

5.4 API 路由

方法路径说明

POST/api/coverage/java/uploadCI Pipeline 直接上传 .exec 文件

GET/api/coverage/java/reports/{report_id}/htmliframe 渲染 MinIO 上的 HTML 报告

5.5 Celery 异步任务

@celery_app.task(name="coverage_java.build_and_collect", bind=True, max_retries=2)
def enqueue_java_coverage_task(self, **kwargs):
    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop(); asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
    try:
        build_result = loop.run_until_complete(BuildService().run_with_coverage(**kwargs))
        if not build_result.exec_file.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f".exec 文件未生成: {build_result.exec_file}")
        report_id = loop.run_until_complete(JaCoCoReportService().generate_and_store(
            exec_file=build_result.exec_file, project_id=kwargs["project_id"], ...))
        return {"report_id": report_id, "build_duration_ms": build_result.duration_ms}
    except Exception as e:
        raise self.retry(exc=e, countdown=30)
    finally:
        loop.close()

6. 与现有链路的集成

6.1 PlanRun.target_lang

# PlanRun 模型加一个可选字段
class PlanRun:
    target_lang = Column(String(20), nullable=True, comment="python/java，None 则自动检测项目")

# TestPlanService.run() 里新增分支
async def run(self, ...):
    plan_run = PlanRun(project_id=..., plan_id=plan.id, ...)
    await db.add(plan_run); await db.flush()
    if plan_run.target_lang == "java":
        await enqueue_java_coverage_task.apply_async(kwargs={
            "plan_run_id": plan_run.id, "repo_url": project.git_url,
            "commit_sha": plan_run.commit_sha, "project_id": project.id,
            "session_id": f"{plan_run.id}_{plan_run.commit_sha[:8]}",
        })

6.2 PlanRun 完成自动汇总

async def on_plan_run_completed(plan_run_id: int):
    plan_run = await plan_run_repo.get(plan_run_id)
    if plan_run.target_lang == "java" and plan_run.execution_succeeded:
        await wait_for(
            coverage_java_tasks.filter(plan_run_id=plan_run_id).all(), timeout=120)
        await UnifiedCoverageService().summarize(plan_run_id)

class Settings(BaseSettings):

    JACOCO_CLI_JAR: str = "backend/app/modules/coverage_java/tools/jacococli.jar"
    JACOCO_RT_JAR: str = "backend/app/modules/coverage_java/tools/jacocoagent-rt.jar"
    JACOCO_VERSION: str = "0.8.11"

    # 统一默认规则
    JACOCO_DEFAULT_INCLUDES: list[str] = ["com/yourcompany/**"]
    JACOCO_DEFAULT_EXCLUDES: list[str] = [
        "**/*Test*.class", "**/*Config*.class",
        "**/*$$Lambda*", "**/*$Proxy*",
    ]

    # 执行环境
    COVERAGE_WORKSPACE: str = "/tmp/ccp-coverage"
    NATIVE_IMAGE_BIN: str | None = None  # GraalVM Native Image 路径

工具 jar 自动下载（启动时）

def ensure_jacoco_tools(settings: Settings):
    downloads = [
        ("jacocoagent.jar",    "org/jacoco/org.jacoco.agent/0.8.11/org.jacoco.agent-0.8.11-runtime.jar"),
        ("jacococli.jar",      "org/jacoco/org.jacoco.cli/0.8.11/org.jacoco.cli-0.8.11-nodeps.jar"),
        ("jacocoagent-rt.jar", "org/jacoco/org.jacoco.agent/0.8.11/org.jacoco.agent-0.8.11-runtime-rt.jar"),
    ]
    tools_dir = Path(settings.JACOCO_AGENT_JAR).parent; tools_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for fname, path in downloads:
        target = tools_dir / fname
        if not target.exists() or target.stat().st_size < 1_000_000:
            url = f"https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/{path}"
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, target)
            logging.info(f"Downloaded {fname}: {target.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")

8. 错误处理与熔断

8.1 分级处理策略

错误类型处理用户可见
git clone 失败任务重试 2 次PlanRun.status = failed
构建失败（编译错误）终止覆盖率采集，BuildLog 完整保留PlanRun.status = partial，build_log 可查
.exec 未生成（Agent 未注入）任务重试 1 次JavaCoverageReport.status = failed
.exec 为空（测试全失败）跳过报告生成JavaCoverageReport.status = skipped
XML 解析失败（版本不兼容）降级：只返回 overall counters明细为空，overall 仍显示
MinIO 上传失败保留本地路径，标记 upload_failed显示"本地暂存"
大项目内存爆maxclasses=100000 熔断 + 分批收集部分类无覆盖率

8.2 Agent 参数校验（启动时）

def validate_agent_config(self, agent_args: dict) -> None:
    assert agent_args["includes"], "includes 不能为空"
    assert "java/*" not in agent_args.get("excludes", "")
    assert 1_000_000 < Path(self.jacoco_agent).stat().st_size < 10_000_000

9. 前端设计（核心）

前端是本次扩展的重点

覆盖率从 PlanRun 的附属提升为独立一等实体，前端需要：任务列表 CRUD、主动触发采集、详情页含代码 Diff 预览（增量标红 + 覆盖标绿 + 覆盖率百分比）、趋势图。以下是完整设计。

{ path: '/coverage/:taskId/code', name: 'CoverageCodeDiff',   component: () => import('../views/coverage/CoverageCodeDiffView.vue') }

9.5 代码 Diff 预览（增量标红 + 覆盖标绿）

这是用户描述中最核心的 UI 能力。每个被采集的类，后端返回 **Git diff unified diff** + **JaCoCo XML 里的行级 missed/covered 数据**，前端合并后用 diff2html + highlight.js 渲染：

# CoverageCodeDiffView.vue 核心逻辑
<template>
  <div class="coverage-code-diff">
    <el-page-header :content="`${detail.package_name}/${detail.class_name}`" @back="$router.back()">
      <template #content>
        <el-tag type="danger">行覆盖率 {{ detail.line_rate }}%</el-tag>
        <el-tag type="warning">分支覆盖率 {{ detail.branch_rate }}%</el-tag>
        <el-tag v-if="diffBaseBranch">增量对比 {{ diffBaseBranch }}</el-tag>
        <el-tag v-else type="info">增量对比上次采集</el-tag>
      </template>
    </el-page-header>

    <div class="legend">
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="badge added" /> 新增（未覆盖）</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="badge covered" /> 新增（已覆盖）</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="badge modified" /> 修改（未覆盖）</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="badge missed" /> 存量（未覆盖）</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="badge unchanged" /> 存量（已覆盖）</span>
    </div>

    
    <div class="diff-container" v-html="renderedDiff" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
// 合并 diff + coverage 标记
const renderedDiff = computed(() => {
  // diff_html 来自 diff2html：后端生成 git diff unified，前端渲染
  // coverage_map: { line_num: 'covered' | 'missed' | 'partial' }
  return mergeDiffAndCoverage(diff_html.value, detail.value.line_coverage_json)
})

function mergeDiffAndCoverage(diffHtml, coverageMap) {
  // 遍历 diff 里每个  行
  // 给  追加 CSS 类：
  //   .jacoco-covered  → background: rgba(5,150,105,0.15)
  //   .jacoco-missed   → background: rgba(220,38,38,0.18)
  //   .jacoco-partial  → background: rgba(217,119,6,0.18)
  // 同时区分 git diff 的 added / modified / removed（用 diff2html 自带的 .d2h-code-line-add 等）
  const rows = parseDiffHtml(diffHtml)
  for (const row of rows) {
    const lineNo = row.dataset.lineNo
    if (!lineNo) continue
    const cov = coverageMap[parseInt(lineNo)]
    if (cov) row.classList.add(`jacoco-${cov}`)
  }
  return rows.innerHTML
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.diff-container :deep(.jacoco-covered)  { background: rgba(5,150,105,0.15) !important; }
.diff-container :deep(.jacoco-missed)   { background: rgba(220,38,38,0.18) !important; }
.diff-container :deep(.jacoco-partial)  { background: rgba(217,119,6,0.18) !important; }
/* Git diff 本身的 added/modified/removed 由 diff2html 默认样式处理 */
</style>

9.6 后端 API 完整清单

方法路径说明
覆盖率任务 CRUD（新增）
POST/api/coverage/tasks新建覆盖率任务
GET/api/coverage/tasks任务列表（分页 + 筛选：service/branch/status/owner/date）
GET/api/coverage/tasks/{id}任务详情（含当前 report 摘要）
PUT/api/coverage/tasks/{id}编辑任务
DELETE/api/coverage/tasks/{id}删除任务（软删，保留历史 reports）
主动触发 + 状态
POST/api/coverage/tasks/{id}/trigger立即触发一次采集（异步，返回 report_id）
POST/api/coverage/tasks/{id}/cancel取消正在运行/排队的采集
WSws://host/ws/coverage/tasks/{id}/progress推送采集中进度（clone 10% → build 50% → report 100%）
覆盖率报告查询（原设计补充）
GET/api/coverage/tasks/{id}/reports该任务的历史 reports（用于趋势图）
GET/api/coverage/reports/{report_id}单次采集的完整覆盖率数据
GET/api/coverage/reports/{report_id}/trend多任务/多时间维度的覆盖率序列（ECharts sparkline 用）
代码 Diff（增量覆盖率）
GET/api/coverage/reports/{report_id}/diff/{class_id}后端返回 unified diff + 行级 coverage JSON
GET/api/coverage/reports/{report_id}/incremental整体增量统计（哪些文件哪些行是新增/修改的 + 覆盖情况）
CI 上传（兼容原设计）
POST/api/coverage/uploadCI Pipeline 直接上传 .exec 文件 + git diff

10. 前端交互逻辑与状态流转

核心设计原则

覆盖采集是长时序异步任务（通常 1-10 分钟，极端项目可能 30+ 分钟）。前端交互的核心是：状态即时反馈、进度可感知、失败可重试、不阻塞用户其他操作。

10.1 前端状态管理（Pinia Store）

// frontend/src/stores/coverage.ts
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'

interface CoverageTask {
  id: number
  project_id: number
  services: ServiceRef[]              // [{ name, module, path }]
  branch: string
  diff_base_branch: string
  requirement_ref?: string
  owner_id: number
  status: CoverageStatus             // draft/queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled
  current_run_id?: number
  last_completed_at?: string
  last_failed_at?: string
}

interface CoverageReport {
  id: number
  task_id: number
  run_id: number
  service_name: string
  commit_sha: string
  status: ReportStatus               // running/completed/failed/skipped
  progress: number                   // 0-100
  stage: ProgressStage               clone/build/report/done
  stage_detail: string               当前进度文字："克隆代码..." / "执行 mvn clean test (3/10)"
  line_rate: number
  branch_rate: number
  lines_covered: number
  lines_total: number
  service_errors: { [serviceName: string]: string }   多服务时每个服务的错误信息
}

export const useCoverageStore = defineStore('coverage', {
  state: () => ({
    tasks: [] as CoverageTask[],
    currentTask: null as CoverageTask | null,
    currentRunReports: [] as CoverageReport[],    // 当前 run 下所有服务的 report
    currentReport: null as CoverageReport | null,
    codeDiff: null as CodeDiffViewData | null,
    ws: null as WebSocket | null,
    wsConnected: false,
    wsReconnecting: false,
    filters: { keyword: '', service: [], status: [], dateRange: [] },
  }),

  actions: {
    // --- 任务列表 ---
    async fetchTasks() { ... },
    async createTask(payload) { ... },
    async updateTask(id, payload) { ... },
    async deleteTask(id) { ... },

    // --- 触发采集（核心：异步 + 进度推送） ---
    async triggerCollection(taskId) {
      // 1. 乐观更新：先把本地 task.status 改成 queued
      const t = this.tasks.find(x => x.id === taskId)
      if (t) t.status = 'queued'

      // 2. 调后端异步触发，立即返回 run_id
      const res = await api.coverage.trigger(taskId)
      if (!res.ok) { t.status = 'failed'; return }

      this.currentRunReports = res.reports  // 每服务一个初始 report，status=queued

      // 3. 立即连 WebSocket 推进度
      this.connectProgressWS(taskId)
    },

    async cancelCollection(taskId) {
      const res = await api.coverage.cancel(taskId)
      if (res.ok) this.disconnectProgressWS()
    },

    // --- WebSocket 进度推送 ---
    connectProgressWS(taskId) {
      const protocol = location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'
      this.ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}://${location.host}/ws/coverage/tasks/${taskId}/progress`)
      this.ws.onopen = () => { this.wsConnected = true }
      this.ws.onclose = () => { this.wsConnected = false; this._fallbackToPolling(taskId) }
      this.ws.onerror = () => { this.wsReconnecting = true }
      this.ws.onmessage = (evt) => {
        const msg = JSON.parse(evt.data)
        this._applyProgressUpdate(msg)
      }
    },
    disconnectProgressWS() {
      this.ws?.close()
      this.ws = null
      this.wsConnected = false
    },
    _applyProgressUpdate(msg: ProgressMessage) {
      // msg: { type: 'progress'|'service_done'|'task_done'|'error', report_id, service_name, progress, stage, detail, coverage? }
      const r = this.currentRunReports.find(x => x.id === msg.report_id)
      if (!r) return
      switch (msg.type) {
        case 'progress':
          r.progress = msg.progress
          r.stage = msg.stage
          r.stage_detail = msg.detail
          break
        case 'service_done':
          r.progress = 100
          r.stage = 'done'
          r.status = msg.success ? 'completed' : 'failed'
          if (msg.coverage) Object.assign(r, msg.coverage)
          break
        case 'task_done':
          this.currentTask.status = msg.success ? 'completed' : 'failed'
          this.disconnectProgressWS()
          break
        case 'error':
          r.status = 'failed'
          r.service_errors[msg.service_name] = msg.message
          break
      }
    },

    // --- WebSocket 降级：轮询（WebSocket 不可用时） ---
    _fallbackToPolling(taskId, interval = 3000) {
      const timer = setInterval(async () => {
        const res = await api.coverage.getRunReports(taskId)
        this.currentRunReports = res
        const allDone = res.every(x => x.status !== 'running' && x.status !== 'queued')
        if (allDone) clearInterval(timer)
      }, interval)
    },

    // --- 详情 / Diff ---
    async fetchTaskDetail(taskId) { ... },
    async fetchCodeDiff(reportId, classId) { ... },
  },
})

10.2 按钮三态与状态流转

# 任务列表卡片按钮（核心交互）
# 按钮在 status 变化时自动切换，禁止点击时触发新请求

<script setup>
const emit = defineEmits(['trigger', 'cancel', 'edit', 'delete'])
const store = useCoverageStore()

// 计算属性：按钮三态
const primaryBtn = computed(() => {
  switch (task.status) {
    case 'draft':  return { text: '开始采集', type: 'primary', action: 'trigger', disabled: false }
    case 'failed':  return { text: '重新采集', type: 'primary', action: 'trigger', disabled: false }
    case 'completed':return { text: '重新采集', type: 'success', action: 'trigger', disabled: false }
    case 'queued': return { text: '排队中…', type: 'warning', action: 'cancel', disabled: false, loading: false }
    case 'running': return { text: '采集中 {{ progress }}%', type: 'warning', action: 'cancel', disabled: false, loading: true }
    case 'cancelled':return { text: '重新采集', type: 'primary', action: 'trigger', disabled: false }
    default:        return { text: '开始采集', type: 'primary', action: 'trigger', disabled: true }
  }
})

# 防重复点击：点击后立即 disable，直到 store 状态变化
const onPrimaryBtn = () => {
  if (primaryBtn.value.disabled) return
  emit(primaryBtn.value.action, task)
}
</script>

10.3 WebSocket 进度推送协议

后端 Celery worker 在关键节点发消息；前端按 report_id 路由到对应卡片更新。单 WebSocket 连接推送所有被选服务的进度。

# WebSocket 消息类型（JSON）
# 连接后后端立即推一条 snapshot：当前 run 所有 report 的初始状态

// snapshot（连接后立即推）
{
  "type": "snapshot",
  "task_id": 42,
  "run_id": 7,
  "reports": [
    { "report_id": 101, "service_name": "order-service", "status": "queued", "progress": 0, "stage": "pending" },
    { "report_id": 102, "service_name": "payment-service", "status": "queued", "progress": 0, "stage": "pending" },
  ]
}

// progress（实时进度）
{
  "type": "progress",
  "report_id": 101,
  "service_name": "order-service",
  "progress": 42,
  "stage": "build",           // clone → build → test → report → done
  "stage_detail": "执行 mvn clean test (3/10)"
}

// service_done（单个服务完成）
{
  "type": "service_done",
  "report_id": 101,
  "service_name": "order-service",
  "success": true,
  "progress": 100,
  "stage": "done",
  "coverage": {           // 只在 success=true 时带
    "line_rate": 78.5, "branch_rate": 65.2,
    "lines_covered": 842, "lines_total": 1073
  }
}

// service_error（单个服务失败）
{
  "type": "service_error",
  "report_id": 102,
  "service_name": "payment-service",
  "progress": 70,
  "stage": "build",
  "message": "mvn compile 失败：package com.xxx 不存在",
  "build_log_url": "/api/coverage/reports/102/build-log"
}

// task_done（所有服务完成，run 结束）
{
  "type": "task_done",
  "task_id": 42,
  "run_id": 7,
  "success": true,        // 全部成功 = true；部分成功 = null（看各 service 状态）
  "partial": false
}

# 后端 Celery worker 里发 progress 的位置（示意）
async def run_service(task, service):
    await ws.broadcast(task.id, { type: "progress", report_id: ..., progress: 5, stage: "clone", stage_detail: "克隆代码..." })
    subprocess.run("git clone", ...)
    await ws.broadcast(task.id, { progress: 15, stage: "build", stage_detail: "执行 mvn clean test" })
    subprocess.run("mvn clean test", ...)
    await ws.broadcast(task.id, { progress: 95, stage: "report", stage_detail: "生成 JaCoCo 报告" })
    subprocess.run("jacococli report", ...)
    await ws.broadcast(task.id, { type: "service_done", progress: 100, stage: "done", ... })
# 每 2-3 秒或每个关键步骤发一条；高频服务可节流（每秒最多 1 条）

10.4 多服务任务的前端表现

一个任务覆盖 N 个服务时，前端把每个服务渲染成独立的 progress bar + 状态标签：

# 任务详情页 · 多服务采集进度区域
# 每个服务一行：名称 + 独立进度条 + 状态 + 错误提示 + 覆盖率环形

<template>
  <div class="service-progress-grid">
    <div v-for="serviceReport in currentRunReports"
         :key="serviceReport.id"
         :class="['service-row', `status-${serviceReport.status}`]">
      {{ serviceReport.service_name }}
      <el-progress
        :percentage="serviceReport.progress"
        :stroke-width="10"
        :color="progressColor(serviceReport)"
        :status="progressStatus(serviceReport)"
        :indeterminate="serviceReport.status === 'queued'"
      />
      <span class="stage-detail">{{ serviceReport.stage_detail }}

      
        <el-progress type="circle" :percentage="serviceReport.line_rate" :width="60" />
      </span>
      <span class="error-btn" v-if="serviceReport.status === 'failed'"
            @click="showBuildLog(serviceReport)">查看错误 →</span>
      <el-button v-if="serviceReport.status === 'failed'" type="primary" size="small" plain
            @click="retryService(serviceReport)">重试此服务</el-button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

function progressStatus(r) {
  if (r.status === 'completed') return 'success'
  if (r.status === 'failed')   return 'exception'
  return ''
}

10.7 前端状态流转全景图

10.8 轮询降级 + 重连策略

# WebSocket 不可用时自动降级
# 1. 首次触发时：优先建 WS，连接 2 秒没连上就降级轮询
# 2. 运行中断开：自动重连（指数退避：1s → 2s → 4s → 8s → 放弃），放弃后轮询

class ProgressWSClient {
  const RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS = 5
  const INITIAL_DELAY = 1000
  const POLL_INTERVAL = 3000

  async connect(taskId) {
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        this.ws = new WebSocket(...)
        this.ws.onopen = resolve
        this.ws.onerror = reject
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), 2000)
      })
      this.ws.onclose = () => this._attemptReconnect(taskId)
      return 'ws'
    } catch {
      this._startPolling(taskId)
      return 'polling'
    }
  }

  _attemptReconnect(taskId, attempt = 0) {
    if (attempt >= RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS) return this._startPolling(taskId)
    const delay = INITIAL_DELAY * Math.pow(2, attempt)
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.ws) this.connect(taskId).catch(() => this._attemptReconnect(taskId, attempt + 1))
    }, delay)
  }

  _startPolling(taskId) {
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      const reports = await api.coverage.getRunReports(taskId)
      this.store.currentRunReports = reports
      const allDone = reports.every(x => x.status in ['completed','failed','cancelled'])
      if (allDone) clearInterval(timer)
    }, POLL_INTERVAL)
  }
}

10.9 空态 · 加载态 · 骨架屏

覆盖率任务首次进入或数据稀疏时，用一致的空态降低认知成本：

# 任务列表空态（分三种场景）
# 1) 项目下从未创建过任何覆盖任务
#    → 大图 + "还没创建过覆盖任务" + 主按钮"创建第一个覆盖任务"
# 2) 有任务但当前筛选器过滤掉了全部
#    → 小占位图 + "当前筛选条件下没有任务" + 次按钮"清空筛选"
# 3) 网络请求失败（离线 / 5xx）
#    → 警示图标 + "加载失败" + inline retry 按钮

# 详情页空态
# - task.status=draft 从未触发 → "还没采集过，点开始采集按钮"
# - task.status=queued/running → 不会空，已经有 progress UI
# - task.status=failed 首次失败 → "上次采集失败" + 错误摘要 + "重新采集"
# - task.status=completed 但 run 里 reports 为空（罕见数据不一致）
#   → 提示"数据异常" + admin 入口

# 骨架屏：任务列表 / 详情页首屏 loading
# - 任务列表：每行 6 个灰色条，宽高对齐真实内容位置，闪烁动画
# - 详情页：顶部覆盖率数字 + 中间环形 + 底部进度条骨架
# - 时长控制：200ms 以下直接渲染，超过显示骨架，超过 3s 降级 error

# 骨架屏伪码（Vue 3）
const loading = ref(true)
const data = ref(null)
const load = async () => {
  const start = Date.now()
  try {
    data.value = await api.coverage.fetchTasks()
  } finally {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - start
    if (elapsed >= 200) loading.value = false
    else setTimeout(() => loading.value = false, 200 - elapsed)
  }
}

10.10 错误反馈体系

覆盖任务是典型长时序链路，任一步都可能失败。前端需要分层反馈，而不是笼统一个红色 toast：

# 错误分层（从外到内）
# L1 全局 error boundary → 兜底，意外 JS 崩溃时显示"页面出错了" + reload 按钮
# L2 API 调用错误 → toast + inline error 提示字段级错误
# L3 服务级错误 → 进度条行内显示"构建失败 · 查看日志 · 重试此服务"
# L4 任务级失败 → 详情页顶部 banner，列出全部失败服务 + 各自错误摘要

# 后端返回的错误结构（前端据此渲染）
{
  "detail": {
    "code": "BUILD_MAVEN_FAILED",
    "message": "mvn compile 失败：package com.xxx 不存在",
    "stage": "build",
    "build_log_url": "/api/coverage/reports/102/build-log",
    "service_name": "payment-service",
    "hint": "可能是分支缺少某个依赖提交"
  }
}

# 前端错误码映射表（中文 + 图标）
const ERROR_MAP = {
  BUILD_MAVEN_FAILED:   { icon: hammer,       text: "Maven 构建失败" },
  BUILD_GRADLE_FAILED:  { icon: hammer,       text: "Gradle 构建失败" },
  TEST_EXEC_FAILED:     { icon: video-play,  text: "测试执行异常" },
  REPORT_GENERATE:      { icon: document,   text: "JaCoCo 报告生成失败" },
  GIT_CLONE_FAILED:     { icon: link,       text: "拉取代码失败" },
  JACOCO_XML_EMPTY:     { icon: warning,   text: "JaCoCo XML 为空（Agent 未注入？）" },
  MINIO_UPLOAD:         { icon: upload,    text: "报告存储失败" },

# build_log 查看：弹窗 iframe 拉 MinIO 存的原始 maven/gradle 输出

10.11 权限 · 并发保护 · 幂等

长时序采集最怕两件事：两个用户同时点触发 和 重复点。前端在请求层 + 后端幂等 key 双重保护：

# 前端层：按钮级防重 + 后端 409 拦截
const triggering = ref(false)
async onTrigger(taskId) {
  if (triggering.value) return
  triggering.value = true
  try {
    await api.coverage.trigger(taskId, {
      headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': `coverage-trigger-${taskId}-${Date.now()}` }
    })
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.status === 409) {
      ElMessage.warning("已有采集正在进行，请等待完成或取消")
      await store.fetchTaskDetail(taskId)
    }
  } finally { triggering.value = false }
}

# 权限：按钮 visibility
const canEdit = computed(() =>
  currentUser.role in ['admin','qa_lead'] ||
  currentUser.id === task.owner_id
)
# 非 owner 看到：
# - 触发 / 重试 → disabled + tooltip "仅负责人或管理员可触发"
# - 编辑 / 删除 → 隐藏
# - 查看详情 → 正常

# 并发数全局限制（后端返回 503 + Retry-After）
# 前端 banner：
"当前并发采集数已达上限（3），请稍后再试或联系管理员扩容"

覆盖任务是多次快照，不是单次结果。详情页需要展示历史演进和对比能力：

# 详情页顶部历史切换器：run history strip（横向时间线）

10.13 任务列表筛选器交互

任务列表的筛选是高频操作（排查"这个任务最近为什么总是失败"）。筛选器需要 URL 同步 + 持久化：

# 筛选器组件
# - 关键词：任务名 / 服务名 / 负责人 模糊匹配（debounce 300ms）
# - 服务多选：来自该 Project 的 services 列表
# - 状态多选：draft / queued / running / completed / failed / cancelled
# - 时间范围：创建时间 / 最后采集时间，默认最近 30 天
# - 分支：branch 字符串匹配（free input + 常用值下拉）

# URL sync：筛选器变化 → 更新 query string → 刷新后自动恢复
watch(() => store.filters, (f) => {
  router.replace({ query: { ...f, dateRange: f.dateRange.join(',') } })
}, { deep: true })

# 持久化：localStorage 存最近 5 个筛选方案，下拉快速切换
const savedFilters = loadFromLocal('coverage-filter-presets')
const savePreset = (name) => {
  savedFilters.push({ name, ...store.filters, savedAt: Date.now() })
  saveToLocal('coverage-filter-presets', savedFilters.slice(-5))
}

# 未来扩展：选中多个 failed 任务 → 批量重新采集（M5 增强）

10.14 取消与中断的状态补偿

用户点取消后，任务可能在任意阶段被终止（git clone 中 / mvn test 中 / 报告生成中）。前端必须能正确处理残留状态：

# 用户点击"取消采集"后的前端序列
# 1) 弹出二次确认："取消后不可恢复，确定要终止当前采集吗？"
# 2) 调 POST /tasks/{id}/cancel，立即返回 202
# 3) 前端按钮切成"取消中..."（loading + disabled）
# 4) 等 WS 推送 task_done（success=null, cancelled=true）
#    或轮询 poll 到 status=cancelled
# 5) UI 切换：进度条停在取消时的百分比，任务整体标签变成 cancelled
# 6) 已完成的服务保留 results；正在跑的显示 cancelled；未开始的显示 skipped

# 断线后恢复
# - 用户在 WS 断开时关闭了页面，再回来
# - 前端发现 task.status 还是 running → 自动重连 WS，失败则降级轮询
# - 顶部 banner："已恢复采集进度，请稍候..."

# 异常残留：后端进程已死但 DB status 还是 running
# - 后端看门狗（run.heartbeat_at 超过 60s 无更新）兜底置 failed
# - 前端 poll 到 status 变化后，清除进度条，显示最终结果

# 关闭 / 刷新页面
# - beforeunload 里不阻止（长任务不应绑死用户）
# - 下次进详情页 → store.fetchTaskDetail 拉最新 run 状态 → 正常显示
# - 这也是为什么每次进详情页都要 fetchTaskDetail，不能靠 WS 推

12. 风险与应对

风险概率影响应对
目标项目有特殊构建（自定义 wrapper、Lombok、Kotlin）中首次跑不通任务级可覆盖 test_command；后端 _detect_build_tool 兜底 custom
Spring Boot fat jar 下 .exec 为空低Agent 参数没配对预置 LaunchedURLClassLoader 排除 + 任务详情页显示 build_log 链接
GraalVM Native Image低需要 offline 路径自动检测 native-image 命令，独立实现
多服务并行导致 JVM 资源爆中部分服务失败后端限制并发数（默认 3，可配置）；前端每个服务独立重试按钮
JaCoCo 版本升级导致 XML 格式变化低XML 解析失败解析器按 counter 元素类型遍历，降级只返回 overall
WebSocket 不稳定中前端进度卡住自动降级 3 秒轮询 + 指数退避重连
MinIO 存储膨胀（HTML 报告 ~50 MB/次）中存储超支upload 时压缩 + 清理 >30 天旧报告（scheduler）

13. 快速启动命令（M0 验证）

# 任意 Maven/Gradle Java 项目验证 JaCoCo Agent 能否工作
cd /tmp
mvn archetype:generate -DgroupId=com.demo -DartifactId=hello -Dversion=1.0-SNAPSHOT -q
cd hello
# 下载 JaCoCo jar
curl -LO https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/jacoco/org.jacoco.agent/0.8.11/org.jacoco.agent-0.8.11-runtime.jar -o jacocoagent.jar
curl -LO https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/jacoco/org.jacoco.cli/0.8.11/org.jacoco.cli-0.8.11-nodeps.jar -o jacococli.jar
# 注入 Agent + 跑测试
export MAVEN_OPTS="-javaagent:$(pwd)/jacocoagent.jar=destfile=coverage.exec,includes=com/demo/*"
mvn clean test
# 生成报告
java -jar jacococli.jar report coverage.exec --classfiles target/classes --sourcefiles src/main/java --xml report.xml --html report/
# 验证
grep -E '<counter type="(LINE|BRANCH)"' report.xml

14. 增量覆盖率技术方案

核心问题

用户描述中的"增量代码标红"需要解决：Git diff 的行号和 JaCoCo XML 的行级覆盖标记如何对齐？后端怎么做 diff？数据怎么传给前端？

14.1 后端 Diff 生成流程

class IncrementalCoverageService:
    async def compute_diff(self, report_id: int) -> list[dict]:
        report = await report_repo.get(report_id)
        task = await task_repo.get(report.task_id)
        project = await project_repo.get(task.project_id)

        # 1. 确定 diff 基准分支
        #    优先用 report 上缓存的 diff_base_commit_sha（上次算过就不重算）
        if report.diff_base_commit_sha:
            base_commit = report.diff_base_commit_sha
        else:
            #    分支名：任务级 diff_base_branch 覆盖 project.default_main_branch
            base_branch = task.diff_base_branch or project.default_main_branch or "main"
            base_commit = await self._git_merge_base(repo_dir, base_branch, report.branch)
            await report_repo.update(report, diff_base_commit_sha=base_commit)

        # 2. 生成 unified diff（只改增量相关的文件，过滤 services 指定的 module 路径）
        service_paths = [s["path"] for s in task.services]  # ["services/order", "services/payment"]
        diff_output = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "diff", "--unified=3",
             base_commit, report.commit_sha, "--"] + service_paths + ["src/main/java", "src/main/kotlin"],
            cwd=repo_dir, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
        ).stdout

        # 3. 解析 unified diff，提取每个受影响文件的新增/修改行号
        incremental_lines = self._parse_unified_diff(diff_output)
        # incremental_lines = { file_path: { new_line_no: 'added'|'modified' } }

        # 4. 匹配 JaCoCo XML 的行级 coverage 数据
        xml_data = await xml_parser.load(report.xml_report_path)
        for file_path, line_map in incremental_lines.items():
            jacoco_file = xml_data.get(file_path)
            for line_no in line_map:
                cov = jacoco_file.line_coverage_json.get(line_no, 'missed')
                line_map[line_no] = {'kind': line_map[line_no], 'coverage': cov}

        # 5. 统计增量覆盖率（只算新增/修改的行）
        incremental_total = sum(len(v) for v in incremental_lines.values())
        incremental_covered = sum(
            1 for lm in incremental_lines.values()
            for v in lm.values() if v['coverage'] == 'covered'
        )

        # 6. 返回给前端：每个文件的 diff HTML + 增量覆盖率数字
        return [{
            "file_path": fp,
            "diff_html": diff2html.convert(file_diff),
            "incremental_line_rate": incremental_covered / incremental_total * 100,
            "incremental_total": incremental_total,
            "incremental_covered": incremental_covered,
            "line_coverage_json": {ln: d['coverage'] for ln, d in line_map.items()},
        } for fp, line_map in incremental_lines.items()]

14.2 两个技术依赖

# requirements.txt 新增
diff2html==3.1.0        # 后端生成 diff HTML（Python 版本）
# 前端 npm 新增：diff2html（JS 版本，比后端生成的更灵活）
# 后端用 unified diff 输出，前端 diff2html 渲染 + 追加 coverage 类名

14.3 edge case 处理

情况处理
merge-base 失败（目标分支与 diff_base_branch 无共同祖先）降级为与上次成功采集的 commit 对比；前端弹窗提示"基准分支无共同祖先，已回退"，管理员可手动修正 diff_base_branch 字段
新增文件（git diff 里没有 old 文件）所有行视为"新增"，覆盖率 0% 的行全部红色
删除文件跳过（不在当前报告里了）
重命名文件git diff 会显示 rename + 内容 diff，JaCoCo 里新路径能匹配就正常处理
JaCoCo XML 里某个 class 行级数据缺失降级：该 class 不显示 Diff，只在表格里显示"无行级标记"
多服务任务：某个服务的 diff 不出现正常——git diff 按 service.path 过滤，未涉及改动的服务跳过

15. 定时调度 + 阈值告警

15.1 定时采集调度器

覆盖 coverage_tasks.cron_expr 字段，用 APScheduler 实现（平台已有依赖）：

# backend/app/modules/coverage_java/scheduler.py
scheduler = APScheduler()

def register_scheduled_collections():
    async def scan_and_schedule():
        async with AsyncSessionLocal() as db:
            tasks = await task_repo.list_active_with_cron(db)
            for task in tasks:
                if not scheduler.has_job(f"coverage_task_{task.id}"):
                    scheduler.add_job(
                        enqueue_java_coverage_task.apply_async,
                        CronTrigger.from_crontab(task.cron_expr),
                        id=f"coverage_task_{task.id}",
                        kwargs={"task_id": task.id, "auto": True},
                    )
    scheduler.add_job(scan_and_schedule, IntervalTrigger(seconds=60), id="coverage-sync")
    scheduler.start()

15.2 覆盖率阈值告警

复用现有 notification 模块（NotificationRule + 飞书/钉钉/HTTP webhook），在 JaCoCoReportService.generate_and_store 的最后加一个判断：

async def _check_threshold_and_notify(task_id: int, report: JavaCoverageReport):
    task = await task_repo.get(task_id)
    alerts = []
    if task.threshold_line_rate and report.line_rate < task.threshold_line_rate:
        alerts.append(f"行覆盖率 {report.line_rate}% 低于阈值 {task.threshold_line_rate}%")
    if task.threshold_branch_rate and report.branch_rate < task.threshold_branch_rate:
        alerts.append(f"分支覆盖率 {report.branch_rate}% 低于阈值 {task.threshold_branch_rate}%")
    if alerts:
        await NotificationService().send(
            event_type="coverage.threshold.exceeded",
            target_user_ids=[task.owner_id],
            context={
                "task_id": task.id,
                "service_name": task.service_name,
                "branch": task.branch,
                "commit_sha": report.commit_sha[:7],
                "alerts": alerts,
                "report_url": f"/coverage/{task.id}",
            },
        )
